quickStart.title: Query the public Flight demo

introduction.title: Query a service that speaks Arrow Flight
paragraphs: Apache Arrow Flight is a protocol for moving table data between services. Airport lets DuckDB attach a Flight server as a database, discover the tables it exposes, and query those tables with SQL.

Use it when your data provider already offers a Flight endpoint, or when you want to serve application data from your own Flight server. Remote results can be joined with local DuckDB tables. You need a running Flight service; the example uses a public demo server.
